tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Ground of dark bands, the page and the nav; text and giant titles on bone bands.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Text and white titles on ink; ground of bone and ruled bands; fill of the solid button.

tokens.name: bone-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, list items and mono labels on ink (6.3:1) and on panel (5.9:1).

tokens.name: lede
tokens.usage: The hero lede paragraph on ink.

tokens.name: body-on-panel
tokens.usage: Body copy that sits in a project's body row on ink.

tokens.name: muted-on-bone
tokens.usage: Mono labels on bone and ruled bands (4.8:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and list dividers on ink.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Fill of torn panels and cards on ink, always under the blotch texture.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Hard offset shadows under panels and cards, and the extrusion behind display type on ink.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: The signal: marker ink, the button slab, the scroll progress line, list crosses, the first section title. Text on ink at any size (5.3:1); on bone only at 24px and up, where it is a mark, not reading text (2.9:1).

tokens.name: tan
tokens.usage: Credit rows, the first project title, brush underlines, the first tape strip. On ink only (9.0:1).

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: The second project title and its credits; a tape strip. On ink only (9.7:1).

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: A third project title; a tape strip; the hue family of the hair sheen. On ink only (7.4:1).

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Archive or secondary titles on ink (9.9:1).

tokens.name: ruled-line
tokens.usage: The 2px rules every 40px on ruled bands.

tokens.name: canvas-light
tokens.usage: Lit centre of the cream canvas behind figures.

tokens.name: canvas-mid
tokens.usage: Middle of the canvas gradient.

tokens.name: canvas-dark
tokens.usage: Edge of the canvas gradient.

tokens.name: canvas-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the canvas, and the ink of figure features (12.3:1 on canvas-mid).

tokens.name: canvas-muted
tokens.usage: Readouts and captions on the canvas: 5.7:1 on canvas-mid, but only 3.5:1 on canvas-dark, so keep this text in the lighter middle of the canvas.

tokens.name: canvas-rule
tokens.usage: The dashed rule above a figure's equation.

tokens.name: canvas-accent
tokens.usage: Constants in a figure's equation. 5.3:1 on canvas-light but 4.3:1 on canvas-mid, just under 4.5:1 for 12px text: the source value, kept exact. Set equations on the lighter part of the canvas.

tokens.name: fig-skin-light
tokens.usage: Particle figures: lightest halftone dot (tone 0).

tokens.name: fig-skin-deep
tokens.usage: Particle figures: darkest halftone dot (tone just under 0.6).

tokens.name: fig-ink-soft
tokens.usage: Particle figures: feature dots at tone 0.6, darkening to canvas-ink at 1.

tokens.name: fig-hair-indigo
tokens.usage: Particle figures: hair strand tips and the dark gaps inside hair.

tokens.name: fig-hair-sheen
tokens.usage: Particle figures: strands inside the sheen band across the crown.

tokens.name: fig-glow
tokens.usage: Particle figures: dots near the cursor blend toward this.

styles.name: t-mega
styles.usage: Section and project titles, uppercase. On the web set it fluid: clamp(72px, 13.2vw, 200px).

styles.name: t-hero
styles.usage: The hero headline, uppercase, one phrase per line. Fluid: clamp(56px, 8vw, 122px).

styles.name: t-card-title
styles.usage: Titles of secondary cards. Fluid: clamp(46px, 5.4vw, 80px).

styles.name: t-statement
styles.usage: A one-sentence statement, uppercase. Fluid: clamp(34px, 4vw, 60px).

styles.name: t-note-title
styles.usage: Titles on taped notes.

styles.name: t-credit
styles.usage: Values in credit rows; labels sit above at half size. Fluid: clamp(20px, 2vw, 30px).

styles.name: t-list
styles.usage: Rows of a display list (tools, languages).

styles.name: t-button
styles.usage: Buttons and display links, uppercase.

styles.name: t-nav
styles.usage: Nav links, uppercase.

styles.name: t-lede
styles.sample: Simulations, chemistry labs and quantum visualisations that run in your browser.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a hero headline, in lede, about 38 characters wide.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: An interactive chemistry lab built on real hydrogen-like wavefunctions.
styles.usage: Running text.

styles.name: t-small
styles.sample: Produced in GarageBand. First tracks coming soon.
styles.usage: Card copy and list items.

styles.name: t-caption
styles.usage: Figure captions, after a FIG. N label in t-button size.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Eyebrow labels, uppercase.

styles.name: t-equation
styles.usage: The real update rule printed under a figure.

styles.name: t-readout
styles.usage: Live figure readouts: counts, cursor position.

styles.name: t-hello
styles.usage: The greeting above a hero headline, rotated -5deg.

styles.name: t-scrawl
styles.usage: Marker notes over titles and panels, rotated -5 to -9deg. Fluid: clamp(20px, 2.2vw, 32px).

styles.name: t-sign
styles.usage: The footer signature, rotated -4deg.

styles.name: t-wordmark
styles.usage: The name in the nav, rotated -3deg. There is no logo; this is the mark.

tokens.name: gutter-min
tokens.usage: Side gutter at phone width; the floor of the fluid gutter.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side gutter at desktop. Fluid: clamp(16px, 4vw, 48px).

tokens.name: wrap-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the content column inside a band.

tokens.name: section-y
tokens.usage: Space above a straddling title. Fluid: clamp(70px, 9vw, 120px).

tokens.name: block-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding around one project block. Fluid: clamp(32px, 4.5vw, 60px).

tokens.name: gap-lg
tokens.usage: Between cards and notes in a grid.

tokens.name: card-pad
tokens.usage: Inner padding of cards and taped notes.

tokens.name: gap-md
tokens.usage: Between a button and the link beside it.

tokens.name: gap-credits
tokens.usage: Between items in a credit row.

tokens.name: gap-sm
tokens.usage: Between stacked rows of buttons and links.

tokens.name: gap-xs
tokens.usage: Between a credit label and value rows when they wrap.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every button, card, note and band. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-torn
tokens.usage: Corner radius of the torn-edge polygon on media panels.

tokens.name: radius-torn-sm
tokens.usage: Corner radius of the torn canvas behind a figure.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Hard offset slab behind torn panels and the figure canvas (drawn as a second torn shape, since a clip hides a box-shadow).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on ink.

tokens.name: shadow-note
tokens.usage: Taped notes on bone.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Buttons at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-button-hover
tokens.usage: Buttons on hover, with translate(-2px, -2px); on press the slab goes to 0 and the button moves 5px.

tokens.name: shadow-photo
tokens.usage: A pinned photo on a panel.

tokens.name: opacity-grain
tokens.usage: The fixed film-grain layer over the whole page.

tokens.name: opacity-rays
tokens.usage: The light-shaft layer in the top right of dark bands.

tokens.name: opacity-tape
tokens.usage: Tape strips over notes and photos.
